name: Katarina
title: the Sinister Blade

Q.name: Bouncing Blade
Q.description: Katarina throws a Dagger, dealing 80/115/150/185/220 + 0.4×AP magic damage to the target and 2 nearby enemies. The Dagger then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.
Q.summary: Katarina throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.

W.name: Preparation
W.description: Katarina tosses a Dagger into the air and gains 50/60/70/80/90% Move Speed decaying over 1.25 seconds.
W.summary: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a Dagger into the air directly above herself.

E.name: Shunpo
E.description: Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger. If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for 20/30/40/50/60 + 0.25×AP + 0.4×AD magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range. Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by (016cd4b3) × (? × 12/11/10/9/8) seconds (0.78+ (by level)). Katarina can blink to any location near the target.
E.summary: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.

R.name: Death Lotus
R.description: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals 25/37.5/50 + 0.19×AP magic damage and ((0.16 × (1 + 3.125×bonus stat)))×bonus AD physical damage, and applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 3 seconds. Total over 2.5 seconds to each enemy: (25/37.5/50 + 0.19×AP) × (6 × 2.5) magic damage and (((0.16 × (1 + 3.125×bonus stat)))×bonus AD) × (6 × 2.5) physical damage.
R.summary: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.

Passive.name: Voracity
Passive.description: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced. If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.
Passive.summary: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced. If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Reset assassin who blinks between daggers and units with Shunpo and picks up daggers for area damage. Every takedown lowers her cooldowns, letting her chain kills with a Death Lotus channel.
strengths: Takedowns sharply reduce her basic cooldowns: chains kills in teamfights
E Shunpo blinks to any unit or dagger (ally, enemy, minion)
Dagger pickups deal heavy area damage
R Death Lotus hits several nearby champions and applies anti-heal
Strong roams with E + W move speed
weaknesses: R is a channel: any stun, knock-up or silence cancels it
Squishy: dies if crowd control lands as she goes in
Weak against tanks and point-and-click crowd control
Short-ranged lane; poke mages push her off farm

curve.lvl1: medium – Q dagger poke, weak trades
curve.lvl3: strong – E onto a dagger: full combo
curve.lvl6: strong – R kill threat in all-ins
curve.items: strong – first item (Nashor's Tooth for on-hit, or Stormsurge/Rocketbelt for burst)
curve.late: strong – reset chains in teamfights, if crowd control is spent

profile.curveNote: Q/W/E are needed together for dagger damage; trades before 3 are weak.
profile.waveClear: poor – Q bounce and daggers, weak early
profile.mobility: high – E blinks, W move speed, resets

Passive.notes: Takedowns lower basic cooldowns; picking up a dagger slashes around her.

Q.notes: Point-and-click dagger that bounces, then lands behind the target.

W.notes: Tosses a dagger into the air; move speed.

E.notes: Blinks to a unit or dagger and strikes the nearest enemy.

R.notes: Channel: daggers to the nearest champions, applying on-hit and anti-heal. Interrupted by crowd control.

profile.windowAgainst: Hold a stun, knock-up or silence for her R. Trade into her when E is down.
